note: City of Lake City park just west of town on County Road N37 beside Lake Creek, run with the Macke family (Tony Macke answers on the campsite's Facebook page). Six small grassy RV spots with electric and water, also used as tent sites; fire pits, playground, shaded picnic area and a bathroom with showers. No dump station noted; no published season or night limit. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 RV ($10 tent), FCFS, showers, water+electric. Site count changed 5 -> 6. The note's '$10/night RV, $5 tent' and its RV Life line were dropped. Pin ~300 m off (moved to the Google/imagery park). Not waterfront stands, re-judged at the real site.
flags: PIN MOVE: the stored pin 42.27330,-94.76520 sits in an open hay field NW of the Lake Creek bridge. Google Maps puts Mike Macke Memorial Park at 42.27164,-94.76237, where Esri imagery shows a green-roofed restroom, playground, shelter and a small gravel loop off County Road N37. Suggested pin 42.2717,-94.7622 (~300 m SE). The stored waterfront_evidence ('6 sites in open mowed clearing ... continuous treeline') was read at the wrong pin and is not evidence.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands on the corrected spot. Lake Creek is ~15 m wide (creekside class if anything) and runs ~30-40 m south of the camp area. The park's own loop/park road and a belt of trees lie between the developed area and the creek, so creekside is blocked (AWH 2026-11-01), and there is no creek-view value. Individual pads are not resolvable.
PHONE: the city lists two numbers, 712-464-3185 (stored; city) and 712-830-0521 (the number on Google's listing). Consider adding the second.
AMPERAGE: stored electric 30 comes from earlier note prose. The city page says only 'electrical hook-ups'; amperage unverified, left as stored. Google 4.9 stars / 10 reviews.
FIT: no length posted; 'small grassy' RV spots. A 23-ft rig is probably fine (caveat unchanged). The rate page is undated but live.
